frequency_question: How often do bilateral resource treaties within 30 months of expiration get formally renewed or extended?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral resource-sharing, river basin, or boundary water treaties that reached within 30 months of their expiration date. Excludes multilateral treaties and non-resource security pacts.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and continuity mechanisms
US-Canada Columbia River Treaty regime extensions/discussions
Senegal River Basin Development Organisation (OMVS) convention renewals
Lake Chad Basin Commission operational renewals

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 named; representative of major bilateral river sharing renewals globally.
known_gaps: Minor bilateral irrigation agreements omitted due to lack of standardized public tracking.
skeleton: 6 historical major bilateral water resource treaty milestones approaching expiration within a multi-decade sample
validity_reason: Bilateral hydro-diplomacy norms change slowly over decades; this base rate remains stable through the end of the decade.
